targets.email_verification_source: London Geothermal's current official About page identifies Eren Gunuc as founder of London Geothermal Ltd and CEO and co-founder of QBIVIO UK Energy. Women in Geothermal's current leadership page publishes eren@gunuc.com.
facts: London Geothermal develops and advises on geothermal, heat-network and net-zero energy solutions in the UK and international markets.
Eren Gunuc works across geothermal engineering, investment advisory, heat networks, project development and clean-energy technology.

themes.title: Energy Transition Strategy
themes.context: Geothermal and low-carbon heat projects require alignment among technology, investment, regulation, public institutions, infrastructure owners and operating customers throughout development.
themes.contribution: I bring renewable-energy, mining and stakeholder-governance experience that adds operator-side judgment to strategic energy development, institutional engagement and implementation planning.

themes.title: Government & Regulatory Coordination
themes.context: Large clean-energy projects depend on permitting, public-sector alignment, community confidence, evidence discipline and sustained engagement with multiple authorities and partners.
themes.contribution: I bring direct experience coordinating ministries, regulators, executive teams and external stakeholders around complex industrial projects, commitments and decision dependencies.

themes.title: Growth & Institutional Partnerships
themes.context: Scaling geothermal solutions requires credible partnerships with investors, councils, asset owners, technology providers, strategic customers and public institutions across markets.
themes.contribution: I support partnership development, stakeholder mapping, government engagement and executive coordination across country-level growth opportunities and regulated project environments.
